I have read that there are over 90 computers in newer cars and I can feel them whenever I'm driving. When I step on the gas there's a delay between the time I put my foot down and the car accelerating. I don't really like it but I'm getting used to it.

The delay is because there is no longer any mechanical connection between the gas pedal and the throttle on the engine; the gas pedal is connected to 2 position sensors which are an input to a control module, which in turn actuates an electric motor to open and close the throttle plate. The reason for this is because traction control and stability control systems (now mandatory on new cars sold in the US) need to control engine speed to operate.
